mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count, AVG(rating) AS average_rating FROM product_reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_published = TRUE

SELECT review_id, member_id, product_id, rating, title, body, is_published AS published, created_at, updated_at FROM product_reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_published = TRUE ORDER BY created_at DESC, review_id DESC
SELECT review_id, member_id, product_id, rating, title, body, is_published AS published, created_at, updated_at FROM product_reviews WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_reviews ( member_id, product_id, rating, title, body, is_published, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{rating}, #{title}, #{body}, TRUE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE product_reviews SET rating = #{rating}, title = #{title}, body = #{body}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND product_id = #{productId}
